# WIREFRAME - HANDOFF-DEMO

## WF-001 Part lookup

Full-width scan button at the top. Below it, a manual code field for when the
camera is unavailable. Result area shows part code, description, and on-hand
count in a large numeral readable at arm's length on a tablet.

## WF-002 Stock adjustment

Two buttons: Consume and Receive. A numeric keypad for whole pieces only. The
current on-hand count stays visible above the keypad. A confirmation line states
the resulting count before the user commits.

## WF-003 Part photo

A single thumbnail with an Attach control. Selecting a file replaces the
thumbnail. No camera capture in this slice.
